def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[1.0 if s == l else 0.0 for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum]).reshape(n, -1)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S])
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    def ll(cols):
        Z = np.column_stack([base] + [X[:, j] if not isinstance(j, tuple) else X[:, j[0]] * X[:, j[1]] for j in cols])
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            d = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - m)); b += d
            if np.abs(d).max() < 1e-7: break
        m = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(m) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - m)))
    def pv(lr): return stats.chi2.sf(max(2 * lr, 0), 1)
    sel = []; L0 = ll([])
    for k in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, s]) < 0.9 for s in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        g = {j: ll(sel + [j]) - L0 for j in cand}
        j = max(g, key=g.get)
        if pv(g[j]) > (0.05 if k == 0 else 0.01) / p: break
        clus = [c for c in cand if abs(R[c, j]) >= 0.6 and g[c] >= g[j] - 2]
        if len(clus) > 1:
            def sumgain(c):
                Lc = ll(sel + [c])
                return sum(ll(sel + [c, o]) - Lc for o in clus if o != c)
            j = min(clus, key=sumgain)
        sel.append(j); L0 = ll(sel)
    while len(sel) > 1:
        Lf = ll(sel); dr = {s: Lf - ll([t for t in sel if t != s]) for s in sel}
        s = min(dr, key=dr.get)
        if pv(dr[s]) < 0.01 / p: break
        sel.remove(s)
    if sel and pv(ll(sel) - ll([])) > 0.01 / p: sel = []
    prods = []; Lb = ll(sel)
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    P = (P - P.mean(0)) / (P.std(0) + 1e-9)
    sc = np.abs(P.T @ (y - y.mean())) / np.sqrt(n * y.mean() * (1 - y.mean()))
    top = [pairs[i] for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]]
    alpha = 0.01 / len(pairs); res = []
    for a, b in top:
        mains = sel + [c for c in (a, b) if c not in sel]
        lr = ll(mains + [(a, b)]) - ll(mains)
        if pv(lr) < alpha: res.append((lr, a, b))
    for lr, a, b in sorted(res, reverse=True):
        if len(prods) >= 2 or {a, b} & {c for pr in prods for c in pr}: continue
        mains = sel + [c for c in (a, b) if c not in sel] + [c for pr in prods for c in pr if c not in sel]
        mains = list(dict.fromkeys(mains))
        lr2 = ll(mains + prods + [(a, b)]) - ll(mains + prods)
        if pv(lr2) < alpha / (5 if prods else 1): prods.append((a, b))
    if prods:
        mains = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [c for pr in prods for c in pr]))
        Lf = ll(mains + prods)
        keep = [s for s in sel if s in {c for pr in prods for c in pr} or pv(Lf - ll([t for t in mains if t != s] + prods)) < 0.01 / p]
        sel = keep
    drv = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [c for pr in prods for c in pr]))[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [c for pr in prods for c in pr]))
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drv), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
